goal: Allow running txindex on pruned nodes so disk-constrained users can index and look up transactions
Return candidate block hashes via RPC and REST when a transaction sits in a pruned block
Enable already-pruned nodes to build a partial index starting from their oldest retained block
agreement: Concept approval for enabling txindex on pruned nodes (l0rinc, ajtowns, arejula27)
Nonblocking objection: missing block hashes are embedded in error strings instead of structured data (arejula27)
Earlier concern about supporting already-pruned nodes was addressed by the author (mzumsande)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it removes the long-standing incompatibility between transaction indexing and block pruning
Users with limited disk space can index transactions without storing the full blockchain history

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it exposes candidate block hashes in lookups so callers can fetch pruned blocks on demand
The interface updates are an incremental addition to support the core pruned txindex workflow
